sloka: न एव सा निर्गमम् लेभे जटा मण्डल अंततः ।तत्र एव आबंभ्रमत् देवी संवत्सर गणान् बहून् ॥१-४३-९॥
transliteration: na eva sā nirgamam lebhe jaṭā maṇḍala aṁtataḥ ।tatra eva ābaṁbhramat devī saṁvatsara gaṇān bahūn ॥1-43-9॥

translations.english: There the golden Ganga wandered about for many years. Bhagiratha not finding Ganga, once again resorted to great penance.
